statement: On 33 fresh prime-order Weierstrass curves (2^22-2^26), 22 paired configurations per cell, counted F_p operations (I = 3/10/30 M, S = M) with hash/solver ops at 0/0.1/1 GAE: multi-target IC4 costs 0.91-0.95x per target of the cheapest of four pre-registered rho arms (rho, rho2, rho2x, rhoseq x 3 kappa) at T = 16384 (cheaper at every I/M and h, bootstrap 95% upper bound < 1); unranked at T = 4096; dearer at T = 1024 (1.05-1.19x); and 1.18-1.80x a paired BSGS everywhere.
